subject: Aaron Olapade Campaign Kickoff
overview: Supporters gathered for Aaron Olapade's campaign kickoff for the Medford School Committee, where speakers highlighted his civic background and core campaign platform.

items.title: Introduction and Endorsement
items.summary: State Representative Sean introduced Aaron Olapade, highlighting Olapade's legislative internship work, his Medford Public Schools background, and his focus on equity and school funding.

items.title: Candidate Platform Address
items.summary: Aaron Olapade reflected on his roots as a Medford student and community liaison before outlining core platform priorities centered on equity, safe learning environments, educator support, and community collaboration.
